defects.problem: The prereg defines first-break features, aggregate-baseline features and leave-one-system-out absolute rank error, but never specifies the predictive mapping/model used to turn either feature set into a held-out late-outcome rank. Linear regression, kNN, ordinal fit and other choices can produce different scores.
The phrase 'same sign when recomputed on the next 5 observations' does not uniquely specify whether segment endpoints move, whether the candidate split stays fixed, or how pooled scale is recomputed.

negative_preservation: Do not choose a predictor after inspecting additional cluster trajectories.
Do not repair C033 and rescore the same exposed target as confirmatory evidence.
Only cluster0 exposure may inform a future discovery-only parser sanity check; a new confirmatory gate needs an untouched external corpus and fully specified predictor.
